title: feat(core,objectql,spec,service-record-context,mcp,runtime)!: a context pack is identified by its package and its name; get_record_context selects a pack by its face on both MCP doors
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ
Fixes #37216
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #37177

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：两个应用各自带了同名的资料包时，外部 AI 通过 MCP 读取记录资料能按“应用＋名字”分别选到各自的包；只给名字且有两个应用都带这个名字时，会被明确拒绝并列出每个可选的写法。
- 为什么做：属于“在一条记录上问 AI”专题，落实已合并的资料包身份裁决（资料包按应用＋名字认），也为后续“技能指定资料包”那张卡扫清前提。
- 出错会怎样：只影响资料包的选取与同名校验；第一方应用里没有任何同名资料包，现有部署读到的结果不变，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无

## What changes
ADR-0150's addendum (PR #37209, merged by the maintainer) puts the context pack in bucket 3 beside `skill`: a pack is identified by its package and its name.

- **The four lists.** `ai_context` joins `PACKAGE_SCOPED_TYPES` (`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`, the one ADR-0150 D3 rule), `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` (`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-read.ts`, the `/meta` by-name read and its `?package=` qualifier), `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_METADATA_TYPES` (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`, the metadata service's per-`(package, name)` slot; uninstall drops one package's pack and keeps another's) and `NAMESPACE_UNIQUE_TYPES` (`packages/objectql/src/namespace-co-owner-names.ts`, D2's refusal of a second holder inside one namespace, at install and in `os validate`).
- **Reader 1, pack selection** (`packages/services/service-record-context/src/read-set.ts`). Candidates are still the packs rooted on `objectName`. `context` is read as a skill prompt's name is: a face (`NS-NAME`, `deriveAiFaceName`) answers its one pack; a bare name resolves by D3 as a caller with no package (the environment's pack, else the one package holder, else `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming each candidate by its face). `RecordContextDoor` gains an optional `packageNamespace(packageId)`; the tool description teaches `NAMESPACE-NAME`.
- **Both MCP doors place a pack's package.** The `/mcp` route (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`) implements `packageNamespace` through `packageNamespaceOf`, on the engine resolved beside the `listContextPacks` read, as `listSkills` does. The stdio bridge (`packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts`) implements it from its `engine`'s registry (the `objectql` service, the same record `installedPackageNamespace` reads for skill prompts). Both sit on top of #37255's `stripReadDecorations` listing, unchanged.
- **The several-packs answer** (triage row 7154571964, ADR-0160 D4 step 3 as amended by #37196): each pack is listed by its face with its label, in en and zh-Hans; a pack with a blank label is listed by its face alone.
- **The overlay consequence** (card What 4, ADR-0150 D4 as ruled for `skill`): a package-less `ai_context` row under a name a package ships is that holder's customization and is not served, read at `(type, name)` whatever the row's root. Measured by a §5 pin with a control in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.reads-environment-only.test.ts`.
- **ADR-0087 semantic entry** `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ai-context-package-scoped-name.ts`, registered by the changeset's `registered ai-context-package-scoped-name` marker.

**Narrowings, each measured on first-party trees** (objectstack at `d7f299c0`, re-read at this head; hotcrm at `9b735103`): the one declarer of packs, `examples/app-showcase` (`src/ai/record-context.ai-context.ts`), ships two packs of different names (`showcase_project_brief`, `showcase_task_notes`) in one package; hotcrm declares none.

| Narrowing | First-party count |
|:---|:---|
| A second holder of a pack name inside one namespace: refused at install (`422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`) and by `os validate` | 0 |
| `GET /api/v1/meta/ai_context/NAME` with no package, for a name two packages hold: first match becomes `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` | 0 |
| A package-less pack row under a name a package ships: not served (the holder's customization) | 0 |

## Tests
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-record-context-tools.test.ts`: a new top-level `describe` on the stdio bridge whose engine's registry places two packages: each same-name pack reached by its face, alike over MCP-over-HTTP and stdio; the bare name refused `409` naming both faces; a control engine with no registry spells each pack bare, so no face reaches one (`404`).
- `packages/runtime/src/mcp-record-context-tools-bridge.test.ts`: in the real-protocol `/mcp` harness, two packages of two namespaces ship `rcd_brief` on one root: each is reached by its face, and the bare name is refused `409` naming both. The door's member pin lists `packageNamespace`.
- `packages/services/service-record-context/src/__tests__/record-context-tools.test.ts`: a new top-level `describe` for selection by `(package, name)`: each of two packages' same-name packs reached by its face; the bare name refused `409` naming both faces with nothing read; uninstalling one holder keeps the other; environment pack first under D3; the root narrows before D3 picks; the several answer by face and label in en and zh-Hans, with the blank-label fallback; a door without `packageNamespace`.
- `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-keyed-plural-read.test.ts`: the pinned slotted set gains `ai_context`, so every plural-read case runs for it.
- `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts` (#32521 priming): the two host-file cases spelt the host's file `helper.TYPE.yml`, which the pass never reads for `ai_context` (the registry declares `**/*.ai-context.yml`). They now spell the file from the type's registry pattern. Every assertion is unchanged, and the `ai_context` cases assert the slotted behaviour every other type already had.
- objectql and CLI enumeration pins (`registry-namespace-co-owner-names`, `package-scoped-exact-qualifier`, `package-scoped-e8-readers`, `manifest-service-residual-namespace-name`, the CLI's `namespace-co-owner-names`) list `ai_context` where it moved.

## Acceptance notes
- **Owed item 3 of the hand-off is folded into this PR.** Both doors' `packageNamespace` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`, `packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts`) waited for PR #37255 (#37243), which edits the same `listContextPacks` regions. It landed after #37255 merged: `main` was merged in at `057cedfa` (no rebase), and the doors were built on its `stripReadDecorations` listing (commit `1deea31f`).
- `record-context-tools.zod.ts`'s `context` describe still says "by name"; the addendum makes it a face or a bare name. Noted for #37141, which owns that key.
- The contract review at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`) is run by the zone, not here.
